title: Listening Drill — Student travel survey
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Student travel survey
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on student journeys. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try interviews first. But watch out for selection bias. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is random sampling. Bring the question sheet to our next meeting, so we can check which terms need defining. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
